decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun no later than 19th February 2019.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Arboricultural Development Report Ref. TF/DR/999revC by Tree:Fabrik, Daylight & Sunlight Report ref. MC/SD/ROL7256 by AnsteyHorne, Construction Traffic Management Plan BLX-15-003-01 inbound, Construction Traffic Management Plan BLX-15-003-02 outbound, Transport Statement dated November 2015 by TTP Consulting, Code for Sustainable Homes Preliminary Assessment rev. 2 dated 03/09/15 by Green Tiger Sustainability, Energy Statement rev. 3 dated 10/09/15 by Green Tiger Sustainability, Planning Statement RJP:P5700 dated 17/11/15 by Rolfe Judd, all received 27/11/15; Structural and civil feasibility report ref 1012005-RPTSL-001 Rev. D by Cundall, Construction traffic management plan received 08/12/15; Statement of Community Involvement Dated November 2015 by Bell Pottinger received 11/12/15; Phase 1 Geoenvironmental Assessment 1012005.RPT.GL.001 Rev A dated 9/11/15 received 18/12/15; Solar PV Feasibility Table received 10/2/16; drawing no's A TP(90) 001 P4, A TP(90) 002 P04, A TP(90) 003 P4, A TP(90) 004 P05, all received 05/04/2016; drawing no's A TP (90) 006 Rev P01 & A TP (90) 005 Rev P05 (typical cycle rack section detail not approved) received 07/04/2016; A TP (90) 009 Rev P03 received 27/05/2016; drawing no's A TP (00) 102 P02, TP (00) 01 P08, TP (00) 003 P011, TP (00) 004 P07, TP (00) 005 P08, A TP(10) 101 P04, A TP(10) 201 P04, A TP(10) 301 P03, A TP (11) 001 P04, A TP (11) 002 P03, A TP (12) 101 P05, A TP (12) 201 P05, A TP (12) 301 P04, A SK 005 P01, A TP(00) 007 P07, TP (11) 006 P04, TP (11) 004 P03, SK 001, all received 02/08/2016; drawing no. A TP(00) 006 P07 received 21/09/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be constructed in complete accordance with the following approved details: Timber decking, Obscured balustrade glazing, 01 Texture aggregate sett paving - cream, 02 Texture aggregate sett paving - silver, 03 Texture aggregate sett paving - graphite, 06 Texture aggregate sett paving - beige sandstone & Slate roof tiles, all received 08/04/2016; Maranello brickwork & Re-constituted stone / Light bronzed metal window surrounds and frames received 09/09/2016.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The construction of the development hereby permitted shall be carried out at all times in accordance with the Construction Management Plan by RCSB dated 18th May 2016 Revision 2 Received 01/06/2016.

Condition : 6 - The lead contractor carrying out works on site shall be a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details shall be clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 8 - The windows formed in the east flank elevation to each dwelling shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 9 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 10 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, or another such time as agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the approved hard and soft landscape works shall be implemented  in complete accordance with the details shown on the following plans: drawing no's A TP(90) 001 P4, A TP(90) 002 P04, A TP(90) 003 P4, A TP(90) 004 P05, all received 05/04/2016; drawing no's SK_001, A TP (00) 102 P02 and A TP(00) 007 P07, all received 02/08/2016; drawing no. A TP(00) 006 P07 received 21/09/2016.

Condition : 11 - If within a period of two years from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation.

Condition : 12 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of 5 years from the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use. (a) No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority. Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work) or any other BS replacing this. (b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority. (c) The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site. Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 13 - Before any of the dwellings hereby permitted are occupied the local planning authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of Blue Badge holders, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area at any time.

Condition : 14 - Parking at basement level shall be retained solely for the use of the occupiers of properties 1-6 Castle Row and the approved townhouses as shown on drawing ref A SK 005 P01 received 02/08/2016.

Condition : 15 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, the approved cycle parking provision for the development shall be implemented in complete accordance with the details shown on the following plans: drawing no's A TP(00) 008 Rev P04 Received 07/04/2016; A TP(90) 008 Rev P2 Received 20/05/2016; A TP(90) 007 Rev P2 Received 01/06/2016. Thereafter, this provision shall be retained in situ for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 16 - Access to the basement shall be controlled by a traffic light system which prioritises in-movements, details of this shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to first occupation and shall be maintained as such for the duration of use of the buildings unless otherwise agreed in writing.

Condition : 17 - The balustrades to the sunken roof terraces, as shown on drawing no's A TP (12) 101 P05, A TP (12) 201 P05 and A TP (12) 301 P04 received 02/08/2016, shall be fitted with obscure glazing, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 18 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, the approved north and east boundary treatments shall be implemented in complete accordance with the details shown on the following plans: drawing no's A TP (90) 006 Rev P01 & A TP (90) 005 Rev P05 (typical cycle rack section detail not approved) received 07/04/2016; A TP (90) 009 Rev P03 received 27/05/2016.

Condition : 19 - Within six months of the date of this permission, full Design Stage calculations under the Standard Assessment Procedure shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority to show that the development will be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 20 - Prior to first occupation of the buildings, evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and as-built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 21 - Prior to first occupation of the buildings, evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved internal water use calculations.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow amendments to the appearance of the houses in respect of planning permission 00626/A/P2 dated 19/02/2016 for erection of six four-bed town houses with private front and rear gardens, cycle storage and basement car park to provide 29 parking spaces and associated cycle and refuse storage.
